Summary of changes:

## UserProfile component (`app/UserProfile.tsx`)

- **Async server component** – follows the same pattern as `page.tsx`
- **Fetch from `/api/users/profile`** – uses `fetch` like `getProducts()` in `page.tsx`
- **Error handling** – `try/catch` with fallback when the API is unavailable (e.g. build time)
- **Renders name and email** – shows the user’s name and email when data is available

## API route (`app/api/users/profile/route.ts`)

Added a `GET` handler at `/api/users/profile` that returns sample profile data so the component works end-to-end. You can replace this with real auth or database logic.

The component is already used on the dashboard in `page.tsx`, so it will show the user profile when the API returns data.

content.text:
Summary of changes:

## UserProfile component (`app/UserProfile.tsx`)

- **Async server component** – follows the same pattern as `page.tsx`
- **Fetch from `/api/users/profile`** – uses `fetch` like `getProducts()` in `page.tsx`
- **Error handling** – `try/catch` with fallback when the API is unavailable (e.g. build time)
- **Renders name and email** – shows the user’s name and email when data is available

## API route (`app/api/users/profile/route.ts`)

Added a `GET` handler at `/api/users/profile` that returns sample profile data so the component works end-to-end. You can replace this with real auth or database logic.

The component is already used on the dashboard in `page.tsx`, so it will show the user profile when the API returns data.
